QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_50

question.text: Per Section 5.3.5, which of the following factors is considered in the empanelment of SIAs with the SRO?

answer.text: Experience of the individual/firm/institution in assuring non-financial information (with social-sector experience carrying higher positive weight); number of qualifying partners/employees; disciplinary cases as a negative weight; eventually size/nature/scale of funders/projects and specific social-sector expertise
The SIA's location proximity to SEBI offices

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.3.5 lists empanelment criteria: (a) experience in non-financial information assurance with higher positive weight for social-sector experience; (b) number of partners/employees meeting SIA criteria; (c) disciplinary cases/sanctions as negative weight; (d) evolving parameters — size, nature, complexity, scale of funders/projects, specific expertise (nutrition, education, health, water, energy, environment, climate). The Trap: A, C, D are all irrelevant and could raise discrimination/bias concerns — none appears in the workbook. Cross-Exam Context: NISM III-A tests intermediary registration criteria; XXIII's empanelment model is narrower (ICAI-managed SRO).
